ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels to 15% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous white region covering the majority of the fluke surface. Low-intensity black pigmentation is mapped to a continuous trailing edge border and discrete focal spots, including a central cluster at the peduncle junction and 7-9 individual circular spots across the mid-lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an interior angle of approximately 102 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of approximately 45 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration profile. Approximately 16 distinct peaks on the left lobe and 18 on the right lobe. Serration amplitudes vary from 3 to 10 pixels relative to the mean edge trajectory.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips; terminal tips show an upward convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 15-20 dark circular pixel clusters. A primary dense cluster is located directly below the median notch; secondary solitary clusters are distributed symmetrically on the ventral surfaces of both lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent thickening of the black trailing-edge border at both distal tips, forming distinct terminal pigmentation blocks.
